title: Frequency Map

story.briefing: One transmitter is flooding the channel. Its ID appears more than any other in the capture log. Name it, and the valley gate opens.
story.success: Rogue transmitter isolated. The gate to the Programming District unlocks.

description: Given a non-empty array of integer IDs, return the ID that appears most often. If several IDs tie for most frequent, return the smallest of them.

examples.explanation: Both appear twice, so the smaller ID wins.

hints: Counting how many times each value appears is the whole problem. What structure gives you a count by key?
Comparing every element against every other element works, but grows quadratically — the large hidden inputs will time out.
Build a map from ID to count in one pass. Then walk the map once, keeping the entry with the highest count, and on equal counts keep the smaller ID.
